Yahoo SGA scope unclear (10.36B vs PDF 14.95B; ~30% off); not used as candidate. Phase H2.2 Sub-B: HK Yahoo SGA alias restored under source_aliases.by_market.HK.yahoo (market-scoped). Spot-check on 00001/2025 + 01113/2025 confirmed Yahoo SGA scope ≠ PDF (00001 PDF reports 'Office and general administrative expenses' 9,466M HKD as one component vs Yahoo SGA 16,491M HKD; 01113 has no single SGA PDF line). HK Yahoo SGA rule stays provider_semantics_unverified — alias provides candidate matching but source_policy still classifies the bucket as terminal_unverified.

After Phase H2 sign-normalization analysis (Module A), residual gap (~2.9% on 600519/2024) reflects timing rather than scope; no primary promotion warranted. Locked as terminal_unverified across CN+HK.
